description: Ed25519 public keys from 32-byte seeds. Each seed is SHA-256 of the UTF-8 text "tubes-fed.1 vector key <name>". WebCrypto imports a seed as PKCS#8: the 16 bytes 302e020100300506032b657004220420 followed by the seed; Go uses ed25519.NewKeyFromSeed. The key is the raw 32-byte public key, base64url without padding (43 characters).
